concerns.text: The dataset citation 'Simon et al., DOI ‑019‑1234' is malformed (truncated DOI, no prefix) and appears in three places (FR-016, SC-013, Assumptions). The idea document instead names a Figshare 'Permeability of gases in MOFs' dataset with NIST/ICSD fallback — the spec never reconciles these. Given the prior kickback concern about the experimental-data source, the spec should name one canonical, verifiable source consistently.

FR-013 ('MUST include a weight-decay term of 1e-5') restates a hyperparameter already fully specified in FR-004 ('weight decay = 1e-5'). Redundant, not contradictory, but FR-013 adds no requirement beyond FR-004; consider merging or scoping FR-013 to the optimizer configuration check only.

US-1 scenario 1 says the pipeline outputs 'all valid gas-framework pairs ... (up to a maximum of 500)', while FR-001 says 'filtering to a representative subset'. 'All pairs, capped at 500' and 'representative subset' are different selection rules; the spec should state one rule (e.g., top-500 by some criterion) in both places.
